title: September 2026 — 29-Gallon Aquarium R&D Journal
body: September documented another unusually slow nitrate accumulation cycle, a preventive September 5 water change and precautionary pre-vacation September 26 water change, the addition of more than 10 Blue Diamond Neocaridina shrimp from Aquashella, continued Thrive S dosing, cooler seasonal temperatures, and vacation preparation. The observations show a trend in this aquarium and do not establish that any single change caused the lower nitrate accumulation.
quick_facts: Balance Experiment; September 5 preventive water change: ~99% sump / ~50% display; September 26 pre-vacation water change: ~99% sump / ~75% display; Blue Diamond Neocaridina shrimp: >10, exact quantity unknown; Thrive S: 4 pumps on September 15, 22, and 26; top-off: 18 containers recorded; temperature: 79.8°F to 76.4°F; BBA stable without obvious significant spread
nitrate_ppm: September 1: approximately 20–40 ppm, closer to 20; September 4: approximately 20 ppm; September 9: approximately 5 ppm; September 15: approximately 5–10 ppm; September 22: approximately 5–10 ppm; September 26: approximately 10 ppm before water change and approximately 0 ppm after water change
